questions.prompt: What is the correct syntax for a while loop?
questions.explanation: C# requires parentheses around the condition: while (condition) { }.

Which loop checks the condition after the body executes?
questions.explanation: The do-while loop is a post-test loop; it checks the condition after running the body.

questions.prompt: What happens if the while condition is false on the first check?
questions.explanation: Because while is a pre-test loop, if the condition is false initially, the loop body is skipped entirely.

Can a while loop have an empty condition expression?
options: Yes, it becomes an infinite loop
Yes, but only in debug mode
questions.explanation: C# requires a boolean expression inside the parentheses. while(true) is the idiomatic way to write an infinite loop.
